title: Chapter 453 Wang Shuo Fights The Sword God Alone
content:
Chapter 453 Wang Shuo Fights The Sword God Alone

Wang Shuo stood up again, swallowed the blood in his mouth, and took a drop of water of life.

This was just for extra insurance.

At present, Wang Shuo's only move that could threaten the Sword God was Shura Slash.

You must find the right time.

As the strongest king, he must have his own unique skills.

The most powerful move of the Sword God is "Sword Heart Clear", which is an auxiliary move to improve his own insight and reaction.

After it is activated, the combat effectiveness will be greatly improved in a short period of time, which is similar to Wang Shuo's "On Protracted War", both of which improve their combat effectiveness.

To deal with Wang Shuo, the Sword God did not think that the opponent was qualified to let him activate his big move.

The two fought again, with spears and swords clashing, and sand and stones flying.

Soon, Wang Shuo was slapped away by the Sword God again.

The Sword God had found that it seemed difficult for him to break the opponent's armor, so he chose to use fists and palms to attack Wang Shuo.

This palm made Wang Shuo complain bitterly.

Blood gushed out of his mouth again.

It seems that he can't delay any longer.

Wang Shuo swallowed the blood in his mouth and rushed up quickly.

Just after taking two steps, Wang Shuo used the "multiplication technique" to increase his momentum to the strongest king.

The sudden increase in momentum may give the Sword God an illusion.

Sure enough, the Sword God was stunned for a moment.

Wang Shuo was very close to the Sword God, and he used the "iron chain binding" again.

This was to be more secure, and everything was in preparation for the final blow.

"Ashura Slash".

Wang Shuo finally used it, which was enough to kill the strongest king.

This time, Wang Shuo was not as well prepared as the last time he dealt with the Demon King.

The accumulated anger was a little insufficient, but the power of this move was already devastating.

The dozens of meters long light blade cut a gap in the city wall.

Everyone looked into the smoke and dust, wanting to know whether the Sword God was injured or killed.

"Ahem." The Sword God coughed.

"I really underestimated you. The power of this move is still so great!"

The Sword God walked out of the smoke and dust without any signs of injury.

Wang Shuo couldn't believe that his painstaking attack did not cause any damage to the opponent, which made Wang Shuo very uncomfortable.

"Do you think I will be fooled by the same move for the second time?"

Wang Shuo swallowed his saliva and asked in disbelief: "How did you block it?"

"Haha, do you want to know? Why don't I take you as my apprentice and I will tell you." The Sword God joked.

Wang Shuo stared at the Sword God with wide eyes and didn't speak.

"Okay, this farce should end."

"Call out the second prince, and I can spare your life." The Sword God thought he had won and was a little complacent.

"What second prince?" Wang Shuo was a little confused, but he already had a guess in his heart.

"Don't play dumb. It seems that you won't cry until you see the coffin."

As soon as the voice fell, the Sword God grabbed Wang Shuo again.

Wang Shuo also risked his life and released the Demon King and the Ice Phoenix Emperor.

The moment he saw the Ice Phoenix Emperor, the Sword God was furious.

"It was all because of you, the damn guy, that you destroyed my resurrection formation, causing Cai Yi to be unable to be resurrected. I want you to be buried with her."

The Sword God was a little hysterical.

Zhao Bangde, who was far away, was shocked when he heard the word Cai Yi.

The melee started in the low sky of Tiexue City.

The two helpers invited by the Sword God also joined the battle.
